annotatedSteps.description: Selection of the correct MCQ option
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Multiple options given ((A) or (C)); writing alternative options is invalid and scores 0.

teacherNote: Marked against: Correct option (A) or 10/9 (1). Offering multiple alternative choices like '(A) or (C)' is treated as an ambiguous response and is awarded zero marks. Always commit to a single definite option after working it out: refractive index of Y with respect to X is (4/3) / (6/5) = 10/9, which corresponds to option (A).
